subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as the public plugin SDK seam for allowlisted model diagnostics, or should model-usage consumers wait for a provider-scoped/non-diagnostics usage contract instead?
rationale: The patch is focused and well-proven, but it creates a new public SDK contract and related usage-accounting work shows competing directions for model usage exposure.

options.title: Accept the opt-in diagnostic stream
options.body: Refresh the SDK surface artifacts, keep the non-integrity caveat, and land this focused observability API for cost and span plugins.

options.title: Prefer a provider-scoped usage seam
options.body: Pause this PR and route usage-accounting consumers toward a provider-owned model usage contract rather than diagnostics.

options.title: Defer public API expansion
options.body: Keep trusted model diagnostics internal until maintainers define a broader plugin telemetry roadmap.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in diagnostic stream
recommendation.body: Refresh the SDK surface artifacts, keep the non-integrity caveat, and land this focused observability API for cost and span plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent overlap across diagnostic-runtime, trusted diagnostics, and Plugin SDK surface budgets.
